inputs.text: pixel art sprite, game asset, 32-bit pixel art. A huge sand shark boss seen from the side, facing left, with a shovel head: its head is long, low and flattened like a crocodile's snout or a guitarfish, much flatter and wider than a normal shark's head, a wide flat jaw full of teeth along the bottom of it, small eyes high on top so it can watch while buried. Thick thorny ridges of bone spikes run from the top of its head down the middle of its back as a row of spines with red tips. A low wide body, broad flat pectoral fins, a tall blade dorsal fin, a long tail with a sickle fin. Smooth scales, dusty brick red back with darker bands like a sandfish skink, pale sand belly. Menacing, gritty detailed 32-bit arcade boss sprite. Clean dark outline, crisp shading with few colours. The whole body inside the image with clear margins. One creature only. Plain flat uniform blue grey (#56616c) background, no floor, no sand, no water, no text.
